name: Transaction Date
meaning: When the transaction happened, with the time zone.

name: Type
meaning: charge, refund, dispute, adjustment, reserved funds and others: the split places rows by it.

name: Order
meaning: The order number, where there is one.

name: Card Brand
meaning: visa, master, amex and so on.

name: Payout Status
meaning: pending, or the status of the payout it went in.

name: Payout Date
meaning: The date Shopify sent the payout to your bank. The split groups rows by it.

name: Available On
meaning: When the money became available for payout.

name: Amount
meaning: The transaction amount: refunds and chargebacks are negative.

name: Net
meaning: Net: The difference between the amount and the fee.
